rule: Every interrupted, development-only, mismatched, or superseded artifact remains visible here and is excluded from formal estimators and publication figures unless an entry explicitly says retained_negative_result. No row may be silently deleted because its result is unfavorable.

entries.scope: all transport, mechanism, and publication estimators
entries.reason: The WSL resource-reconfiguration interruption occurred after only 26.2 ps of the planned 500 ps production trajectory and before a complete temperature checkpoint existed. The clean restart began 700 K from zero.

The original occupancy-0 repeats used 10 ps equilibration while primary formal points use 20 ps and did not form a balanced occupancy-by-velocity design. Exact-structure matched replacements are frozen in llzto_velocity_nested_v2.json.

Version 1 independently repeated structural relaxation for each velocity cell and therefore did not isolate velocity initialization. Version 2 reuses each primary run's exact hashed relaxed structure.

The conventional-cell task independently ordered disorder and was not an exact periodic supercell of the primary occupancy realization, confounding size with Li/Ta configuration. The exact determinant-two matched supercell replaces it.
The original fixed-volume task used 10 ps equilibration rather than the primary run's 20 ps. A matched 20 ps replacement is frozen separately.
The first pilot predates the corrected reverse-jump risk set and deterministic crystallographic site-model fingerprint. Its large reverse fraction is invalid and must not be quoted.
These intermediate reruns were created during the reverse-risk-set and circular-null audit. Version 4 is the final corrected pilot sensitivity result.

entries.scope: method qualification only; not a formal transport or mechanism estimate
entries.reason: All nine assignment settings pass quality, but string-excess significance is not stable across the frozen grid (empirical p spans approximately 0.005 to 0.423). This negative robustness result is retained and forbids a pilot cooperative-string claim.
The 20 ps series was used to validate execution and adequacy diagnostics. Its unresolved diffusion values are not combined with 500 ps formal trajectories.
The 12-snapshot feasibility set may guide pass, domain narrowing, or fine-tuning design. Only the disjoint 30-snapshot publication-heldout set can authorize publication claims.
